== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Heart's Gem is a premier natural treasure recognized as the world's most significant source of Blood aura{{!}}blood aura. It is described as a petrified, shimmering brick or scarlet chunk of congealed [[blood]] that can be kept in a glass [[tank]]. This object was formed from the [[blood]] of the [[Redmoon Herald]], who previously served as a [[Blood Shadow]]. The gem is capable of emitting massive amounts of Blood aura{{!}}blood aura, though its power can diminish if it is not replenished. It has been used to facilitate training, such as when [[Ruby]] absorbed its [[aura]] to develop a version of the Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body.}}
